notes: Topline: Primary objective = move inference into private VPC across regions (EU-only for EU policy, UK region, Canada data locality for PII, APAC for APAC products).
Customer quote: "We cannot have EU customer PII leave EU boundaries — that is non-negotiable."
Architecture ask: Private control plane + data path in customer's VPC, KMS BYK (bring-your-key) with HSM compatibility, and per-region audit logs retained for 7 years (compliance).
Latency targets: 50-120ms p95 for chat/agent flows in primary regions (UK, EU); lower priority for batching ML workloads in APAC (throughput-focused).
Cost sensitivity: medium-high — insurer expects predictable committed spend (reserved capacity) and tooling to reduce token unit cost (batching + prefix cache).
Model preferences: preference for private hosted open models (quantized variants) and ability to route to cheaper fallback models for non-PII requests.
Routing: must support policy-based routing by region + automatic fallback to dedicated pool if private region is degraded; customer wants explicit routing controls in config (no black-box).
Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required; legal requested sample penetration test report and audit_log retention policy (we provided templates, awaiting legal signoff).
Integration notes: Looking for KMS integration options (AWS KMS in customer account for AWS deployment, Google KMS for GCP in Canada region) — customer will not hand over keys to vendor.

SE notes (Evan): POC plan = 6-week on-premise-like VPC deploy in dev->staging->prod with per-region KV cache disabled for EU to ensure residency verification; will demo audit log streaming to customer's Splunk instance.
CSM (Priya) added: Post-deal success plan includes runbook for rotation + incident response; retention SLAs for logs and monthly compliance review cadence.
Sales cadence: Demo completed 2026-02-15; security workshop 2026-03-02; legal expects DPA back by 2026-03-20; procurement pricing review week of 2026-03-22.
Reference artifacts: security FAQ, draft SOW (attached), compliance playbook stub, Fireflies transcripts linked above.
